title: WOC Simulated Cricket Stats
scope: Global simulated player stats for the curated country, franchise/domestic, international-veteran, and saved-team pool; no server or user identifiers are exported.
coverage_note: Players outside the public/coverage pool remain in the simulator database. Partnership-by-partnership, ball commentary, toss decisions and exact batter-v-bowler pairs are not stored in the current sim-stat database.
